auditTrail.note: In line with a 1914 agreement between the Leeds and Salford dioceses, the boundaries of St Joseph''s would be those of the Borough of Todmorden as incorporated in 1896, or after its dissolution in 1974, the boundaries of today''s Todmorden Town Council.
